title: Salesforce Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Healthcare Provider Industry Cloud Platforms
summary: Agentforce Health helps health systems unify patient data and deploy autonomous AI agents to deliver faster, more personalized care.
body_markdown:
Salesforce has been recognized by Gartner as a Leader in the 2026 Magic Quadrant for Healthcare Provider Industry Cloud Platforms.


In this inaugural report, Gartner evaluated global healthcare[provider](https://www.salesforce.com/healthcare/providers/?d=cta-body-promo-8) industry cloud platform (HP-ICP) vendors based on their Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. In our opinion, the research talks about the rapid shift among health systems toward integrated, cloud-native architectures capable of bridging operational silos, orchestrating patient care, and scaling intelligent automation across the enterprise.


Open Image Modal


# Image Modal


## **Empowering health systems with Salesforce for Healthcare**


Beyond the market context provided in the report, Salesforce continues to advance healthcare innovation, enabling health systems to unify front-, mid-, and back-office operations:


- **Data interoperability and trusted context:** Turn disconnected records into a trusted understanding of patients and members with a governed data foundation through[Informatica](https://www.salesforce.com/informatica/?d=cta-body-promo-8) ,[MuleSoft](https://www.salesforce.com/mulesoft/?d=cta-body-promo-8) , and[Data 360](https://www.salesforce.com/data/?d=cta-body-promo-8) . By advancing data[interoperability](https://www.salesforce.com/healthcare-life-sciences/healthcare-software/healthcare-interoperability/data-interoperability/?d=cta-body-promo-8) across legacy systems, care teams and AI agents gain a complete, real-time view of the patient journey.
- **Autonomous AI and workflow automation:** Built on enterprise-grade security and governance, Agentforce Health features a library of purpose-built, autonomous AI agents that automate labor-intensive administrative tasks, including contact center support, benefits verification, and patient access.
- **Composable architecture and low-code agility:** Utilizing visual tools like[Omnistudio](https://www.salesforce.com/industries/omnistudio/) , Flow Builder, and[Agentforce Builder](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agent-builder/?d=cta-body-promo-8) , health systems benefit from a flexible, composable workbench. This agile architecture allows organizations to rapidly deploy digital experiences and configure custom AI agents using natural language.
- **Interoperable, open ecosystem:** Through[AgentExchange](https://agentexchange.salesforce.com/?d=cta-body-promo-8) , provider organizations can discover and deploy thousands of vetted third-party applications and specialized healthcare AI agents within a secure framework supported by Salesforce’s governance capabilities.


## **Driving value and efficiency for healthcare providers**


Healthcare organizations of all sizes, ranging from physician groups and community hospitals to large enterprise health systems, leverage Salesforce to ease everyday pain points like scheduling delays, referral bottlenecks, and manual intake so they can expand provider capacity and deliver more personalized care experiences.


“Healthcare providers are moving quickly to unify their clinical and engagement data so they can deliver seamless, proactive patient experiences,” said LaShonda Anderson-Williams, Chief Business Officer & General Manager of Agentforce Health at Salesforce.


“We believe our placement as a Leader in the inaugural Gartner Magic Quadrant validates our commitment to helping health systems automate administrative workflows, empower care teams, and drive measurable business value with trusted AI.”
